title: Google DeepMind's Lila Ibrahim, world's top AI 'readiness' officer, on preparing for what's to come
summary_full: Google DeepMind Chief AI Readiness Officer Lila Ibrahim may be the only person with that title, and as intelligence risks rise, she takes it very seriously.
